name: Northflank Sandboxes

modes.label: Managed cloud, predefined compute plans
modes.note: Plans = $0.01667/vCPU-h + $0.00833/GB-h exactly (monthly price = 720 h). Plans below 1 vCPU are shared CPU; 1+ are dedicated. Kata microVM runtime. Billed per second on the allocated plan while running, with no minimum and no start/resume fees. No idle auto-pause: bills until explicitly paused (scale to 0), and pause wipes ephemeral disk and processes. 1 GB ephemeral disk included; 5/10/20 GB options billed at $0.15/GB-month only while running. Verified 2026-09-28 (northflank.com/docs/v1/application/sandboxes/sandboxes-on-northflank-cloud): 'Northflank cloud bills compute per second of runtime' on the selected resource plan (e.g. nf-compute-200) = allocation; 'Pausing a sandbox scales it to zero instances, which stops compute charges'; no idle auto-pause documented.
modes.perf_source: ComputeSDK (github.com/computesdk/benchmarks results/): cold 82.8 ms (seq TTI 2026-08-07, runtime "node", SDK default plan), burst 24,110 ms (2026-09-16, composite 0, ~21% success at 100-way). DAX never succeeded. No HPC result.

modes.label: Managed cloud, custom vCPU/RAM plan (on request)
modes.note: The pricing page says 'Request custom vCPU + memory combinations'. Custom plans are assumed to use the same unit rates (not stated). Enterprise volume discounts/annual commit are unpublished.
modes.perf_source: Same runtime as on-demand; ComputeSDK (github.com/computesdk/benchmarks results/) cold 82.8 ms (2026-08-07), burst 24,110 ms (2026-09-16, ~21% success).

modes.label: BYOC fee only (+ your cloud bill for VMs/GPUs, disk, egress)
modes.commit_note: Your own cloud's spot, savings plans, commits and credits apply to the VM bill; the Northflank fee is unchanged.
modes.note: Northflank BYOC fee from the pricing page's 'Bring your own cloud' tab: $0.01389/vCPU-h, $0.00139/GB-h, BYO GPU $0.00278/GB vRAM-h (GPU map = VRAM GB x 0.00278). It EXCLUDES the underlying cloud VM/GPU, disk and egress, which your cloud bills, so the engine's number is only the Northflank fee (flagged alt). The docs also mention a per-cluster flat fee whose amount is not shown. Kata microVM isolation on AWS needs bare-metal or nested-virt instance types.

modes.label: Managed cloud GPU sandbox (gVisor), combined GPU rate
modes.note: $/GPU-h from the pricing page GPU tab (H200 and B200 appear only in the GPU plan table). Northflank's blog (2026-05-05) says the GPU rate is 'a combined rate per hour' covering GPU, CPU and RAM, so vCPU/RAM are set to 0 here. The docs say to also configure a compute plan; if CPU/RAM are billed on top, add $0.01667/vCPU-h + $0.00833/GB-h. A $50 account credit minimum is needed to deploy GPUs. Up to 8 GPUs per instance; no time-slicing on managed cloud.

plans.name: Developer Sandbox (free tier)
plans.note: 2 free services, 2 jobs, 1 addon, 1 BYOC cluster. Always-on small free plans ('Compute: Limited', exact sizes not published). Payment method required. Not realistic for a sandbox fleet.

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go
plans.note: No seat pricing, unlimited services, per-second pro-rating. Sandbox concurrency limits not published (resource quotas depend on the billing plan).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.note: Invoice billing, volume discounts, annual commitment, BYOC commits, SSO SAML/OIDC, audit logs, SLA, 24/7 support, control plane in your VPC. Prices unpublished.

perf_source: CPU plans (Kata microVM) and GPU sandboxes (gVisor) are different runtimes: perf is on the CPU plan modes.

knobs.label: Time left running after work ends (× session hours; no idle auto-pause)
knobs.why: Northflank has no idle timer: a sandbox bills its full plan until you pause (scale to 0) or delete it. A fleet never paused runs 730 h/month (4.15x an 8 h x 22 d schedule). Default 1 = you pause exactly when work ends; the 5x ceiling is a judgment call.

caveats: BYOC regime is FEE-ONLY (+ your cloud bill): its total excludes the underlying CPU/GPU VMs, disk and egress, so it is not comparable with full-compute rows; it stays alt-flagged (opt-in) and the GPU map is only the $0.00278/GB-vRAM-h management fee, not a GPU price.

BYOC mode prices only Northflank's management fee ($0.01389/vCPU-h + $0.00139/GB-h). The underlying cloud VM, disk and egress are billed by your cloud and not modelled (flag alt). The pricing page also claims 'No added cost for running in your VPC', which contradicts its own BYOC tab.
No idle auto-pause: sandboxes bill their full plan until explicitly paused. Pause wipes ephemeral disk and processes; only volumes persist (billed $0.15/GB-month while paused).
snapshot_gib_month 0 is the vendor's 'no snapshot fees' claim (blog). Container snapshots are written to a configured backup destination whose storage may be billed elsewhere; no memory snapshots.
Egress $0.06/GB with no published free allowance (egress_free_gib 0). Internal platform traffic is free.
GPU mode assumes the blog's 'combined' GPU rate (vCPU/RAM included). If CPU/RAM are billed on top per the docs, GPU costs rise by the compute plan rate. $50 credit minimum for GPUs.
Custom vCPU/RAM plans assumed to use the published unit rates (flag sales). Enterprise volume discounts unpublished.
Plan sizes' disk_gib = 1 GB included ephemeral disk; extra ephemeral (5/10/20 GB) is billed at $0.15/GB-month only while running, not modelled per size.
perf: computesdk cold start median 82.8 ms; burst median 24,110 ms with only 21% success at 100-way concurrency; DAX never succeeded; no hpc CPU benchmark.
max_vcpu 20 / 40 GB = largest listed plan; larger via custom plans or BYOC.

Data residency: project region is fixed at creation and runtime resources stay there, but managed builds run on Northflank build infrastructure outside the project region unless builds are configured on your own (BYOC) cluster. Zurich (europe-west-zurich) is Switzerland, not EU. Tax: EU VAT reverse-charge on valid registration; no blanket VAT on USD list. (patch v10-regional, 2026-09-28)

Jobs and builds: the pricing-page calculator JS (dist bundle) displays job/build time at 2x the service rate (nf-compute-400 job $0.2667/h vs service $0.1333/h); not stated in the static pricing text, so not modelled as a mode. Calculator shows $2.71/$5.41 for nf-compute-10/20 vs table $2.70/$5.40 (rounding). (patch v5-calculators, 2026-09-28, unverified in static page)

fleet.verification: Payment method required for all resource creation, including free selection, for identity/fraud verification. New-account billing threshold $50; higher thresholds limited by past credit purchases.
fleet.tiers: Developer free allowance includes 2 services, but sandbox runtime fleet quota is not specified by that service allowance. PAYG advertises unlimited services; effective limits appear in account settings.
fleet.notes: Do not reuse 2 free PaaS services as a default sandbox count. 10/50/300/1,000 sandbox entitlement requires effective account limits; CPU/GPU default quantities not published in inspected docs. Billing threshold is automatic invoicing, not fleet quota.
